name: WF-051 Unified Operational Control Plane Gate

parameters.jsCode: const input=$json.body??$json; const snapshots=Array.isArray(input.snapshots)?input.snapshots:Array.isArray(input.records)?input.records:[]; const norm=v=>String(v??'').trim(); const lower=v=>norm(v).toLowerCase(); const stageOrder=['new','normalized','qualified','underwriting','offer_ready','offer_sent','seller_countered','contracted','buyer_matching','buyer_selected','transaction_pending','closing_pending','closed','closed_out','reopened','failed','cancelled']; const terminal=new Set(['closed_out','failed','cancelled']); const controls={}; const blockers=[]; const warnings=[]; const queue=[]; const transitions=[]; const identityCoverage=[]; snapshots.forEach((r,i)=>{const id=norm(r.candidate_key??r.normalized_identity_key??r.property_id??r.lead_id??r.deal_id); const stage=lower(r.stage??r.pipeline_stage??r.status); const prior=lower(r.previous_stage??r.prior_stage); const next=norm(r.next_action); const updated=norm(r.updated_at??r.last_updated_at); const source=norm(r.source_workflow??r.workflow); const health=lower(r.health_status??r.health); if(!id){blockers.push({record_index:i,type:'missing_identity',severity:'critical',message:'Canonical identity is required for unified control-plane tracking.'});} identityCoverage.push({record_index:i,has_identity:!!id,identity:id||null}); if(!stage||!stageOrder.includes(stage)){blockers.push({record_index:i,type:'invalid_stage',severity:'critical',stage:stage||null,message:'Record has no supported lifecycle stage.'});} if(prior&&stage&&stageOrder.indexOf(stage)<stageOrder.indexOf(prior)&&!['reopened','failed','cancelled'].includes(stage))transitions.push({record_index:i,type:'stage_regression',severity:'warning',prior_stage:prior,current_stage:stage,message:'Lifecycle stage moved backward without an explicit exception state.'}); if(!terminal.has(stage)&&!next)warnings.push({record_index:i,type:'missing_next_action',severity:'warning',stage,message:'Active record has no explicit next action.'}); if(!terminal.has(stage)&&!updated)warnings.push({record_index:i,type:'missing_update_timestamp',severity:'warning',stage,message:'Active record has no update timestamp for SLA monitoring.'}); if(['failed','reopened'].includes(stage))queue.push({record_index:i,priority:'high',reason:stage,next_action:next||'Review failure/reopen reason and determine the next controlled transition.'}); else if(stage==='offer_ready'||stage==='buyer_selected'||stage==='closing_pending')queue.push({record_index:i,priority:'high',reason:stage,next_action:next||'Review record and advance only after required gate conditions are satisfied.'}); else if(!terminal.has(stage))queue.push({record_index:i,priority:'normal',reason:stage,next_action:next||'Complete the next workflow gate.'}); if(health&&['blocked','critical','failed'].includes(health))blockers.push({record_index:i,type:'upstream_health_block',severity:'critical',health_status:health,message:'Upstream workflow health blocks safe progression.'}); const key=source+'|'+stage; controls[key]=(controls[key]||0)+1;}); const stageCounts={}; snapshots.forEach(r=>{const s=lower(r.stage??r.pipeline_stage??r.status)||'unknown';stageCounts[s]=(stageCounts[s]||0)+1;}); const active=snapshots.filter(r=>!terminal.has(lower(r.stage??r.pipeline_stage??r.status))).length; const critical=blockers.length; const health=critical?'blocked':warnings.length?'needs_review':'ready'; const queueSorted=queue.sort((a,b)=>a.priority==='high'&&b.priority!=='high'?-1:a.priority!=='high'&&b.priority==='high'?1:a.record_index-b.record_index); const next=health==='ready'?'Use the unified control plane as the single operating snapshot and advance records through their declared gates.':health==='blocked'?'Resolve critical identity, stage, or upstream-health blockers before automated progression.':'Review warnings, assign next actions, and update timestamps before relying on the control plane for SLA decisions.'; return[{json:{ok:health==='ready',control_plane_health:health,record_count:snapshots.length,active_record_count:active,terminal_record_count:snapshots.length-active,stage_counts:stageCounts,critical_blocker_count:blockers.length,warning_count:warnings.length,blockers,warnings,transition_warnings:transitions,identity_coverage:identityCoverage,operating_queue:queueSorted,control_group_counts:controls,source_workflows:[...new Set(snapshots.map(r=>norm(r.source_workflow??r.workflow)).filter(Boolean))],next_action:next,policy:{control_plane_only:true,no_automatic_external_side_effects:true,no_automatic_outreach:true,no_legal_validation:true,no_title_clearance_claim:true,no_funding_verification_claim:true}}}];
